description: This file defines a Go struct and associated methods for configuring a Kubernetes ConfigMap volume source in an apply configuration pattern. It includes fields for referencing a ConfigMap, specifying items, default mode, and optionality, along with builder methods for setting these fields.

classes.name: ConfigMapVolumeSourceApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A declarative configuration struct for Kubernetes ConfigMap volume source, supporting method chaining for setting configuration options.

methods.name: ConfigMapVolumeSource
methods.description: Constructor function that creates a new instance of ConfigMapVolumeSourceApplyConfiguration.

methods.name: WithName
methods.description: Sets the Name field in the configuration, enabling method chaining.

methods.name: WithItems
methods.description: Adds one or more KeyToPathApplyConfiguration items to the Items list, enabling method chaining.

methods.name: WithDefaultMode
methods.description: Sets the DefaultMode field with an int32 value, enabling method chaining.

methods.name: WithOptional
methods.description: Sets the Optional field with a bool value, enabling method chaining.
